result.rationale: Verified in the diff: embedding.hbs contains only the hosts table and an add_host button — no save button invoking saveChanges. The controller's saveChanges calls this.get('embedding').update({}) and the server's Admin::EmbeddingController#update merely renders EmbeddingSerializer without persisting anything (unlike EmbeddableHostsController#save_host). So the finding is accurate: dead/no-op code path. Since no user-visible behavior is currently broken, this is a substantive review concern (misleading API surface, silent no-op endpoint), not a bug introduced by the diff.
